name: kognit-frontend-tests
description: Phase 8 frontend behaviour tests plus the P1 security/persistence tests and the Pocket Notes tests. Runs the real template, app.js and vendored DOMPurify in jsdom; test_notes_browser.mjs additionally drives a real Chrome/Chromium/Edge (puppeteer-core, no browser download) when one is installed.

scripts.test: node test_ui_core.mjs && node test_stream_render.mjs && node test_theme.mjs && node test_nav_views.mjs && node test_security_hardening.mjs && node test_notes.mjs && node test_notes_browser.mjs
scripts.test:jsdom: node test_ui_core.mjs && node test_stream_render.mjs && node test_theme.mjs && node test_nav_views.mjs && node test_security_hardening.mjs && node test_notes.mjs
